newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian UCB builds Australian film plant.
newsitem.headline: Belgian UCB builds Australian film plant.

text.p: Belgian chemicals and drugs firm UCB said in a statement on Monday it formed a joint venture in Australia and would invest 1.3 billion francs in a new plant in Melbourne to make speciality films.

The plant, to be run by the joint venture Securency Pty Ltd, would have annual capacity of 11,000 tonnes of bi-oriented polypropylene (OPP) when it comes on stream in August 1998 and have turnover of some 1.5 billion francs, UCB said. The investment will create around 100 jobs.
OPP films are used in packaging, self-adhesive labels and the production of plastic-backed banknotes.
